config.note: sweep cells DO persist JSONL traces (harness writes every run); after persisting results they are moved to journal/sweep-traces/ to keep the top-level journal to the analyzed batches — every cell is regenerable from this repo at seed 0. 'none' schedule disables BOTH env changes and tool churn (true no-churn). 'features' task changes the user task prompt AND the scripted traffic. 'repo2' runs the second fixture repository. mc_nowarm rows are MC with the warmer disabled (composition control for the no-churn null cells).
